title: Command Shell Typography Cohesion
purpose: Make VedaPath typography feel calm, cohesive, and product-grade across every room.
rules: Use fixed type sizes with breakpoint overrides, not viewport-width font scaling.
Reserve hero scale for true heroes only.
Keep cards, rails, forms, and metrics compact enough for repeated product use.
Let source content remain readable before decorative drama.
key_changes: Reduced hero and room title spread so work surfaces feel calmer.
Protected rail group labels from global h2 styling.
Unified card, step, path, metric, form, and control text sizes.
Kept Bhagwa action cues, peacock green trust cues, sacred gold progress, and ivory surfaces consistent.
next_release: Controlled permission execution authorization draft gate
